branches_coordinates_chk.name: branches_coordinates_chk
branches_coordinates_chk.value: ("branches"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("branches"."longitude" IS NULL) AND ("branches"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("branches"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "branches"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

customers_wholesale_status_chk.name: customers_wholesale_status_chk
customers_wholesale_status_chk.value: ("customers"."wholesale_status" IS NULL AND "customers"."customer_type" = 'retail') OR ("customers"."wholesale_status" = 'approved' AND "customers"."customer_type" = 'wholesale') OR ("customers"."wholesale_status" IN ('pending', 'rejected') AND "customers"."customer_type" = 'retail')

customer_addresses_coords_chk.name: customer_addresses_coords_chk
customer_addresses_coords_chk.value: ("customer_addresses"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("customer_addresses"."longitude" IS NULL) AND ("customer_addresses"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("customer_addresses"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "customer_addresses"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

promotion_one_target.name: promotion_one_target
promotion_one_target.value:
(CASE WHEN "promotions"."variant_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "promotions"."product_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "promotions"."category_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "promotions"."brand_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1

promotion_window_ordered.name: promotion_window_ordered
promotion_window_ordered.value: "promotions"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"
